يمتطوا (form VIII)
# يَمْتَطُوا (yamtaṭū) /jam.ta.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
# يُمْتَطَوْا (yumtaṭaw) /jum.ta.tˤaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
